mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, temperatures are hitting 99 degrees with a heat index of 103 near the Military Ridge State Trail, and please note the elevated air quality index of 52.

The city is moving forward with two important initiatives. First, the Senior Center is offering trishaw bike rides along the Military Ridge State Trail, which requires a signed waiver and release of liability form. Also, students are encouraged to design an I Voted sticker for the upcoming election with voting on designs opening soon.
There is plenty to do this week, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness happening today. Tomorrow, you can test your knowledge at Hop Haus Trivia or Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Louie.
Regarding recent activity, on July 21, an officer used a drone to assist the Dane County Sheriff’s Office in locating an individual who fled from a residence in the Town of Springdale.
Cool off today with the Snickers Swirl flavor of the day at Culver's. They are open until 10 PM this evening, so stop by for a treat before they close.
